evidence.title: DayOne data center construction to start in Lahti – SRV strengthens its position in the growing market for data center construction
evidence.excerpt: SRV says it is launching a data-center construction project in Kiveriö, Lahti, for DayOne, with construction work beginning immediately and operations scheduled during 2027.
